text: Amazing breakfast, super friendly service, and beautiful decor. It looks like they've expanded the menu since the last time I was here, and everything was spot on. I had the crème brûlée French toast which was brilliant. Good coffee too! Will be back frequently!
Great spot ! The view is great, the location is perfect and the food is delicious!  This is a place where you want to sit and enjoy to tapas not be rushed. Take it all in and enjoy every bite

Start with oysters, raw and crystal hot sauce was delicious and the oysters were big and I got two free one. The steak tartare with oyster aioli is a must. I was skeptical at first but a friend told me I had to try it and it was amazing--from the bread to the meat to that awesome oyster aioli it's five stars for sure.

AMAZEBALLS!!! Just finished my food and had to leave a review before I left. If you're in the st. Louis area, stop to try it. Very unique with cute outdoor seating. Really good customer service (chick-fil-A status)

This is the best Sushi in town!  It's new and they're crushing it with the food, service and the whole experience. I've been there several times already and have had multiple servers, bartenders and managers. Everyone is over the top fantastic!  Don't listen to the bad reviews, this place rocks the rolls!!  I've also had several of their plates as I've been working my way through the menu. Keep it up!  I love it!  Thanks!
I'm Brooklyn born Brooklyn raised. Best pizza I've eaten in decades period.9 3/4 stars

Our Waitress was Felecia and she was perfect she kept asking if we needed our drinks refilled and got dirty plates out of our way and it was just a great experience overall! I highly recommend her to be your server
The best Thai I've ever had, and I live in New York! My dads go to place so we've ordered multiple times since I've been here. Pad Se Ew, Pad Thai & Egg rolls are my go to, all incredible.

Tarantella's is a mainstay in Medford and for good reason. The portions are huge-every entree I've had is enough for two full dinners. The food is always excellent -I've had linguini with crab, eggplant parm, spaghetti carbonara, and each and every dish hasn't disappointed.
Finally found a place that has tasty street tacos in St. Louis. Will order from here again.

Disgustingly rude staff. Didn't want to accommodate our party with sufficient notice. Didn't bother to try or have us wait. Just said they didn't care because they had "450 reservations for today alone"

The best place to go in Bellevue for smoothies. Great prices and great quality. They have a lot of options and they are all great, imI haven't had one that I didn't love. I garubtee you will find something you like.

Ruben's resembles many authentic cuban cafe's in Miami, for the longest time I have been in the search of finding a true cuban restaurant and my search is finally over! The service was amazing and the environment was overall enjoyable. The food was indubitably delicious! I have lived in Miami for 20 years and feel a sense of nostalgia whenever I visit this location! It's like a piece of home is with me in Tampa! If you ever want to taste REAL AUTHENTIC cuban food I highly recommend having breakfast or lunch at Ruben's!
Has pretty good French toast and great customer service. Food isn't expensive and tastes like it was cooked with quality

Yum! Just ordered 2 giant cheese burgers and a Bacon Western Cheeseburger to go! Fries were incredible and perfect. 

Thank you Archies for the great take-out order to-go service.

Celebrating my son's birthday here. Seems very simple and dark at first but our server was very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu which was greatly appreciated since it was our first time here and the menu is very limited. The appetizers were fresh and tasty especially the edamame. I could have eaten the whole thing myself. The gyoza was tasty and perfectly cooked. All of us enjoyed our Ramen bowls and since it was pouring rain outside seemed like the perfect dish! Would definitely recommend this place for Ramen !!

Great quick and healthy breakfast, average prices for the area. I had the build your own hash with sweet potatoes, bacon, over medium eggs and the herb aioli (I didn't love this and asked for a side of the fire roasted salsa which was great) and the homemade sourdough wheat toast which was delicious. The toast is served with a lemon butter and strawberry jam and was an interesting combo.

Staff was very friendly.. the food however was well below average. My fish was not seasoned well, they also don't have tartar sauce. My rice tasted like I put salt on a spoon and ate it. Brussel sprouts were ok. Mac and cheese was over cooked and not special in any way.

Had the seafood stew, Giuseppe pizza and the tagliatelle.  All three were fantastic.  Honestly, there is more depth of flavor and soul in this food than any other Italian restaurant I've been to in Stl.  Reminded me of meals in Florence.  It was even that good as carry out on a cold New Years Eve.

Fantastic food. We ordered a build your own Supreme Pizza and a spicy Alfredo penne pasta dish. I've never liked ordering supremes pizza's at most pizza shops because there's usually one or two topping I'd prefer to substitute. They've solved that by letting you pick 3M & 3V I highly recommend a: Pepperoni, ground beef, bacon, ricotta, tomato, and onion. Also their crust was delightful. I'm usually found wanting with most pizza crusts opting to drown it in ranch or marinara, but Piezano's pizza crust was too good, ranch would have ruined it. They also usually have home made cookie for sale at the register, I highly suggest getting those as well. We ordered online through their website, very convenient.

We've been on a search for great tasting Nashville hot chicken (tried 7 or 8 now) to replace our absolute favorite at Pearson's Chicken & Fish (it was DA BOMB!) but they appear to have not made it through covid which is very unfortunate.  As we were in Nolensville all day today picking up a few things we decided to give this place a shot.  There Nashville Hot chicken was EXCELLENT!  It had just the right amount of bread on it (some put WAY TOO much bread on the fried chicken), had a very nice hot level (not too hot but enough to make you think about sweating), very juicy, and best of all it has really good flavor.  All the staff there was very helpful even when my scatter brain mucked up the order.  

Highly recommend.
Back bar with tv's and a bartender who knew how to run his bar.  The food was outstanding - this will be a must go to every time I'm in Nashville!

I was excited for my family to try a Chicago style pizza. The pizza was pretty good, of course you can't compare to the real deal. The kids pizza was super cheesy and delicious. We ordered a sausage roll as an appetizer OMG I'm definitely getting that as a main dish, if I ever go back! It was soooooo gooooood! My salad was very disappointing the cucumbers were old and soggy the dressing was watered down dressing you get at a grocery store. The tea was delicious! I was surprised on the service, my kids were super thirsty I had to stop our waiter for more drinks. My biggest dissatisfaction was the restroom, it was disgusting. I wanted to take pictures but there was another female inside and I did not feel comfortable flashing pictures. The sink seemed a little clogged, there were long hairs by the sink, the trash was so full dirty towels had spilled to the floor, and the door was sooooo dirty! I WAS IN SHOCK! Maybe you need to start logging restroom checks. I asked my husband about the men's restroom he said his was clean. This was last week on Friday evening,I can't imagine how that restroom looked after the night ended. My kids loved the pizza and I loved the sausage roll, so there's hope I might give it a second chance...

This place is still open during the COVID quarantine! Just call ahead and place your order for pick up. But onto the review; Me and a coworker placed a order this past Wednesday and we were suppose to have gotten a chicken & shrimp fajitas nachos & a arroz con pollo dish but with fajitas veggies on top of the arroz. When we picked up and got the order, they had made a chicken, steak and shrimp fajitas nachos and they forgot the fajita veggies ontop of the arroz con pollo. My coworker spoke to I believe was a Manuel(??) & and after clarifying a misunderstanding on both sides, he took care of the both of us and give us our correct meal orders the following day. 

If you folks want some really good arroz con pollo & fajita nachos, definitely swing by La Hacienda during this quarantine to satisfy your Mexican cravings. You won't regret it.
Awesome, fresh, plentiful and exactly how you hope it will be! I say summer is here, sit in your own backyard, socially isolate n enjoy.
Went one night with my family to celebrate, amazing experience and really great food, we had a wonderful evening and the staff was extremely polite!

**We dined here before the pandemic in February 2020 and I'm just finishing the review now.

Jacques-Imo's was recommended to us by a lot of the locals and we loved it! We were in town for a bachelorette party and they treated us with real southern hospitality.  We had reservations but we're seated a little later because the party before us had paid, but we're taking their time leaving.  The hostess was really apologetic and would update us about the status of our table.  

We tried the shrimp and alligator sausage cheesecake which was more like a quiche which was interesting, but I wouldn't have ordered it again but some girls liked it.  The fried green tomatoes were 
I also tried the short rib and the seasonal fish they had.  Both were amazing!!  The spinach salad that comes with every entree was refreshing because most of the other stuff were fried.

First dining experience in New Orleans since the reopening of restaurants. We had an amazing experience & spectacular service from Rich. He was very attentive and patient with us while deciding on our orders. We ordered the Stuffed P&J Oysters as an appetizer and they were amazing! The main reason we decided to dine here for my birthday because they are so delicious & unlike any oysters I've had before. Rich was also able to accommodate my needs for not being able to decide between two entrees & giving me a half order of each which made it perfect. Jumbo Louisiana Shrimp & Grits & Louisiana Blue Crab Garganelli. Both full of flavor & the best of both worlds. My boyfriend ordered the Crispy Softshell Crab which paired so well with the watermelon, cucumber, & tomato. He almost licked the plate clean! It was so nice to be in a restaurant again and really appreciate the friendly staff that made our experience so wonderful.

Man oh man I tried them oysters Nawlins style and cant stop thinking about how delicious they were. I'll be the 1st to admit I don't eat oysters and have never had a desire to do so but I took the challenge and tried them. This place had oysters cooked every way imaginable. We tried the grilled Bacon Garlic Oysters w Monterrey Jack cheese....OMG OMG OMG that was some good S@$T. Great food, great service,super attentive bartender and great conversation. When in town this place is a must try.

Stayed in this neighborhood for a long weekend and discovered Molly's the first morning. We returned 2 more times. The baked goods, biscuits, grits and unusual egg dishes were a hit with the 4 in our group.
Always clean! Always piping hot! team members are nice and Trinity is always so sweet!

I love McAlisters but the the women that work there were horrible. The only guy that was there was trying to do this job and help customers but the ladies there were so rude. One older lady in the FOH yelled to the lady in the kitchen about how she would never eat what I ordered as I'm standing right there with other people. I will probably never go to this location again.

I love me some authentic Chinese food and often cook it myself. But Sometimes, all one needs and wants is Americanized Chinese food!! During those times, West End Wok is the place to go. 

I've ordered two postmates orders from here and each time the food arrives piping hot and fresh. Soup is hot and perfect for this weather, crab Rangoon and spring roll are both still crispy. Shrimp lo mein is so good and so is the fried rice, still have that hot wok taste. General chicken is crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The sauce doesn't taste like the generic sauce in a bottle. They also never miss with any modifications to your food. I'm honestly very impressed.

Super good pizza. It's different from the normal chain pizzas so it's a nice change. Nice location and friendly staff. I would recommend this if you want some good pizza that taste like it's from a restaurant.
Pizza shack is a south philly gem. 2 min walk from here and get there pizza, Stromboli and hoagies frequently. Can't go wrong with anything on their menu

Visited this place for the first time over the weekend and it will now be a go to every time I visit Reno! The workers are so nice and the food came out boommbbbb! The portion size was more than worth it. This place is a cute bar setting you can see them cook in front of you, freshly made. Will definitely be back!

Talk about authentic Greek food! The hummus is the best I've had with it's creamy blend of yummy seasonings. The lamb was perfectly cooked and melted in my mouth. The ambiance and decor was loudly Greek! So awesome!
Nice bar. The food was great but took very long. Other than that the decor was beautiful and the people working there were friendly.

Service was ok. Food was too expensive for what we got. I mean in all fairness they did use good ingredients but didn't seem to be seasoned well. The mesquite grilled steak enchilada did not taste like wood fired at all. Tasted like it had been in a steam table for a few hours. The best thing was the cheese enchilada. Seriously; they were awesome. Chips n salsa were just ok. I asked for hot sauce or something spicy and the server brought me chalula??? Really? Why not a homemade salsa or sauce? Place was nice inside but seemed to over complicate the food theme. Rice was nice and fluffy and tender but again underwhelming as far as flavor. Beans were good when I added some salt to them. No sweet tea. Pico de gallo was made yesterday and I know this because I'm a chef. Lettuce on plate was a touch brown. Coke was ice cold and perfect. All I am saying is that for the price I could have went to La Mansion and had some bomb A enchiladas with house made spicy sauces, a giant molcajeta full of grilled shrimp, fresh juicy and flavorful carne asada and steaming with fire roasted salsa. Could have had desert and drinks for the same price as our meal at Superior. It wasn't bad but it left me underwhelmed and desiring more flavor. If you say mesquite grilled steak then make sure it at least tastes like wood fired steak not meat that has been hanging in the steam table. Server was nice but didn't wow either.

I did not think it was as expensive as everyone says because you get all the excellent food you can eat. The steak was really well seasoned and cooked. The place was beautiful and the service was also great.
They have a good selection of dishes for very affordable prices! Can get a bit busy during lunch hours so wait time can sometimes be long.

The food is great. Seafood is top top top. Steak was prime. The staff is very accommodating. We were here for a bachelor party (we were rowdy) and they were still respectful and polite. I would have kicked ourselves out, but they did not. Wine got on my white polo and the staff was able to find a solution and it was cleaned up without a stain! Amazing!
What a treat! There are so many options! The food was fresh and oh so good! Service was awesome as well!

So disappointing! While we were there, they tried to fit 6 of us at a table of 4, even though the place was not crowded. Their tap broke, so no draft beer. They ran out of pasta, so we needed to change our order. And, they mistakenly tried to charge us for the pasta meal that we never received. Reviews looked good on this place, but that was definitely not my experience.

Amazing and delicious. As a California native I've been on the hunt for a taqueria that reminds me of home, and this is it. I got the Al Pastor Quesatacos and they were perfect. Tender, flavorful meat, with generous helpings of cilantro, chopped onion, and pineapple on top. Extra points for the complimentary radish and grilled onions. Salsas were great. Would highly recommend, I want to go back already!

The kids play area is never monitored so you get 12 year olds swinging from the playground while toddlers try to dodge the swinging feet. Why doesn't management intervene? The rules are clearly being broken and its endangering the younger kids but the management just ignores it. Not safe for the little kids!

I have been eating here for over 20 years and it is always good, the Baja fish tacos are a must try  if you have never been here. If you want something  a little lighter the salad is a solid choice (see photo).  It is more of a Cali mex vibe with fresh ingredients and homemade salsas.

I want to preface this statement by saying Lilliana's is currently my favorite food destination in the StL.  But, tonight I ordered and I was disappointed.  Consistency is what I look for and this was not.  I only ordered t-ravs and a meatball sandwich.  When I showed up to pick it up I was rolled they did not have meatballs.  Disappointing they did not have what I wanted but then for the ravs to be burnt and the pasta salad to not have the normal red wine vinegar was disappointing.  I know we are in weird times and I will for sure go back, but I expect more.

Went to Armature Works last Saturday night to celebrate my daughter's birthday and bought a bottle of wine at that main bar when you first walk in.  Goes by the name A W Bar.  The receipt says its called Fine n Dandy.   Anyway, checked my account yesterday morning and they added 20 dollars to the bill.   I called the main # for armature works and apparently this particular establishment has no phone #???   After insisting that they must have some information about this place that rents space in their building, I was able to get a name and email of the manager.   I sent him an email, offering him the opportunity to correct this mistake.   He didn't respond.    So, if you go to the A W Bar at Armature works, make sure you check your receipts and your accounts because they clearly like to give themselves 50% tips.    I don't normally post negatives about businesses, because everyone has a bad day, but stealing money is another story.....

This place is just getting worse. After my first wrong order and review I received a free meal. I went back to get it and my  second order was wrong.   I had a coupon today for a free chicken tender if I ordered a sandwich or salad.  I ordered a sandwich which cost $10 and I received literally  ONE chicken strip free. What a rip off. I couldn't even eat the sandwich. The meat was so tough and dry.  This place is WAY too expensive for what you get.   I give up here.

Don't get the Philly cheesesteak. It was dry , no cheeses to be found and minuscule vegetables. For 11$ totally not worth it. Go to Frankies for cheesesteak or jimmy Johns for great sandwiches. This place is overrated and pretentious. For the prices it sucks. And trust me I can afford it if it's worth it.
Best mussels in Nola, hands down. A lovely experience for our family. Service was great and the entire family loved the experience.
The food and pizza was delicious and super fast delivery also the staff was accommodating to my special requests. I would highly recommend this place and will be ordering again.

There's barely any cheese on their cheesesteaks. Gooey lead me to believe this would the cheesiest cheesesteak ever! I'm very disappointed. I wish I had gone to John's Roast Pork. The staff was very friendly though!

Ordered from here a few times in the search of Phillys best chicken. The half chicken order comes with a couple of different pieces of chicken with bones and all. I ordered every time the sweet and spicy level 2. Tried their Cajun and other sauces on side. The level 2 is their max and provides good heat while still being edible. The chicken crispy isn't like other Korean style double fried chicken but still very tasty. Probably my favorite in Philly that I've tried so far.

I had an issue with the way they changed their fries. I filled out a contact us about it. 

I got a follow up call from zinburger almost immediately. They had great customer service.
Amazing food love everything, it's really hard to decide what to get because everything is soooooo good!!!!!!

I didn't check in but just want you to know that they have a great happy hour. Get there early because it gets crowded. Lots of business types and way more men than women if you want to socialize. Great drink prices and appetizers are at a good price point as well as drinks. Barbecue chicken pizza was yummy and the deviled eggs and bacon, delicious!!  Great service and a cozy atmosphere. When the weather warms up, the patio is an additional perfect seating area.

Terrible. Just ordered on Uber, they got everything wrong. Never gave me the $6 hush puppies I paid for, and i ordered 3 tender meal, plus 2 extra, and they gave me a total of 4. Also, i requested "naked" but of course they gave me tenders with hot pepper sauce on them. O and i didnt order this awful mac and cheese if you call it that...this is going in the trash. Disappointing.

To be honest I wanted to like this place because it's one of the few places we've found in this area that doesn't have pounding music. However the experience was not great. It took 45 minutes for oyster appetizers to be brought out. When they were finally brought out, half the trays had no sauces. We had to ask for crackers twice.No drink refills were offered despite empty glasses for more than an hour. Our server disappeared for long stretches of time.

Honestly this was incredibly disappointing. When you serve food at this particular price point, there ought to be better service. It should not take two hours for the food to come out. We should not go more than an hour waiting for a drink refill.

Well, my experience was not anything to brag about. Customer Service was nice hence the 2 stars. Now, what I went for...the hot chicken. Smallest piece of chicken I've ever received from a restaurant. No flavor nor hot. The okra had absolutely no taste. I was very disappointed but now I can mark this off my list. Go to Prince or Hattie B's if you are wanting good hot chicken and sides.

Really great bulgogi poutine!  You have to get the kimchi, if you like the contrast of flavors to the sweet bulgogi poutine.  It's really akin to throwing spicy sauerkraut to a greasy brat or Reuben.  

Overall the poutine fries were crispy and well put together.  I'll be trying a bowl next time.  My friends had suggested double meat for the future.

Made a reservation for a birthday dinner and requested seating on the back patio - no problem. Called to confirm everything including the back patio request 2 days prior. Still no problem and "thank you for letting us know that this is a birthday." Arrived to find a special event taking up the said back patio, no apology and stuck with a tiny table jammed in against the wall. Loud, overly warm, and just average food - there are too many other good options in the area to bother going back.

I've heard so much of Don Juan's Taqueria!! Especially of the Birria tacos I knew I had to go try them ASAP!  I went on Wednesday night and was able to easily get a parking spot (they have a spacious parking lot available) we were welcomed as soon as we walked in the door the owner Juan welcomed us in and seated us at table he was super friendly and welcoming! We ordered a couple drinks the cantarito I've never had anything like it.. it's very unique but I absolutely loved it! We also had the escorpión, Tereza and el Chapo. The Elote (corn) was incredible especially for it being winder in Indy! It's so difficult to find good corn this time of the year! They have juicy and amazing corn!! We also had the tostada de Ceviche de pescado, and the carnitas sope which was fully loaded!!! We had the birria tacos and let me just tell you... it's so incredibly difficult to find GOAT BIRRIA in Indy!!! Don Juan Taqueria specializes in GOAT BIRRIA!! Their birria tacos are amazingly delicious!! If you haven't had them yet I highly encourage you to do so!!!  The Torta ahogada was wonderful spicy but a good spicy!! The churros and the Sopapilla bites were incredible!! They offer taco Tuesday's! Make sure to stop by to get your taco fix! Can't wait to go back!!
Soooo good. And when I came in, he noticed the coconut rice was a bit low and he wanted to give me fresh rice. It was awesome, even after a few beers. It'd be good drunk, or sober lol

FOOD:
Rating: 5/5
This was my second time at Teriyaki Madness and it did not disappoint. Both times I had ordered a regular size Spicy Chicken with all Veggies. The chicken was relatively juicy with an inspiring spicy sauce. Vegetables were delicious which is definitely a rarity for me. What surprised me the most was the nutrition facts that were posted on the menu. The Spicy Chicken alone was only 375 calories with the Veggies adding on an additional 145 calories. An entire filling meal for slightly over 500 calories is quite the feat for many restaurants. Separately, I did have a bite of my wife's order of Tofu Teriyaki. My experience with tofu is absolutely lacking, but with that being said, this was the best tofu I have ever had.

SERVICE:
Rating: 5/5
Although not a traditional sit-down restaurant, when service was provided, it was done with a smile. We were given a quick overview of the restaurant items along with the process of ordering. During my first visit, I was given a wonderful fork/chopstick combo. I asked for an additional one to take home and they gracious enough to give me an extra pair.

CLEANLINESS:
Rating: 5/5
When we arrived on a Tuesday around 5pm, the restaurant was relatively empty. The general restaurant area, tables, and restroom were very clean.

PRICE:
Rating: 3/5
My Spicy Chicken with Veggies was $8.79. The prices for regular sized meals range from $8-$9 and larges from $10-$12. Although the meal was satisfying, the general quantity of food for tha

Always delicious. I could drink the buffalo butter on its own with a buffalo butter sauce chaser....it is really that good. I always order extra so I can bring it home and use it throughout the week on chicken and whatnot. This is our favorite place to go for a weekend lunch.  It's tasty, clean, and casual yet with a nice atmosphere.
We stayed at a close by hotel and luckily I gave a shot to this restaurant at my first day in Clearwater beach, we had our lunch everyday in this spot, delicious food and friendly staff
their coffee is so good and i love coming here. the atmosphere is cozy and reminds me of the winter near the fireplace. the drinks are so good and they're sweet to their costumers!

I got their tonkotsu ramen and miso ramen, both broths lacked in flavor. With our orders we were supposed to receive salads and never got them. Their Philadelphia roll was absolutely disgusting and the cream cheese they used was cheap. When asked if we could switch the ramen for another option, the manager replied with " I've never gotten complaints. It's just your acquired taste". When we ordered miso soup, our bowls had lipstick, but we complained so many times we just decided to switch the bowls to the edamame bowls. I regret this choice for Valentine's Day. The drinks were good though.

Boy would I love to give them 5 stars!  There's only one thing holding me back. For what it's worth, my experience was 4.5.  In summary, I'll be back!!

Why not 5 you ask?  I'll get to that - let me first gab about all the great things!

Right from entering, I was in love with the design - it's right up my alley: modern, clean, chic, fresh.  Each table arranged with a small candle and plant, flower or succulent centerpiece.  My friend and I used the yelp waitlist as we weren't sure how busy it'd be, and as soon as we arrived we were greeted and shown to a table.  

Our server, Nick, came to our side immediately with water, a smile, and informing of us of the night's cocktail.  I passed on a drink and my friend went with the grapefruit Paloma. She loved it and said it was a little boozy!  Looking over the menu, I was torn, but there's always next visit, right?

My friend ordered the Brussels sprouts taco app to start and I went with a salad. She devoured her tacos so they must have been good, haha. My salad was not short on flavor.  The dressing seemed a little oily, but that could just been my opinion.  For our meals, my friend ordered the truffle risotto and I the salmon dinner.  She let me try her risotto and it was AWESOME! It also was not short on flavor and the amount of truffle present was perfect. My salmon dinner was also worth getting again.  The fish was cooked perfectly, just to flaking, and the seasoning was enough for Iron Chef. There was a spicy whipped cream of
Dinner and Cocktails were outstanding! The shrimp and catfish were delicious. The coleslaw was even worth talking about. A must go to spot in NO!

Holy Cow! This place is the bomb!
Food so tasty. Very relaxed atmosphere. 
Good vibes. Excellent place to chill.

This was an unfortunate dining. I ordered the alligator and stony grits but the meat was too bready. It tasted like smothered pork chop. If you've had it, you get the issue. y friend had the shrimp and grits, though. That was amazing! The drink order was wrong. We ordered the St. Pierre not knowing they brought out the Duval instead. When we tried to reorder, it wasn't the same thing! We knew what we ordered but instead of fixing the issue, the waiter though it best to argue us down on what we asked for. So we asked for the check. What killed this rating from a 3 star to a 1 star was the MOUSE that was wandering around the restaurant! Yuck! Never again!

Absolutely Covid CLEAN! We went to breakfast and had a delicious bowl w egg, tons of bacon and avocado. We also enjoyed a champagne split as well. Never disappoints! We were super impressed w the tables being wiped down between customers and food brought out by friendly and accommodating servers. We will be back!

One of the better meals I've had in a while. I'm not fond of black beans (unfortunate reality of a vegetarian) so was disappointed with their only veggie burger option being black bean however the toppings were so incredible it didn't matter. I ended up getting the mushroom truffle on veggie burger and it was awesome. The onion strings were a great crunch, mushroom and cheese is always a beautiful combo, and arugula for that fresh flavor combination. Also got a large order of the chilli lime fries which we loved. The aoili sauce they serve on the side went perfect with everything.

We ordered for pickup but got to sit outside with our food which was really refreshing since it hasn't been possible until now with Covid.

The customer service was great, bathroom pretty clean. No complaints!!
Bouncer is a virgin loser. He has no sense and is a retard .he is so broke  he is the scum of the earth

I enjoy the customer service and restaurant atmosphere at Sabrina's but unfortunately I've been disappointed time and time again with their food... it's never properly cooked and fails to have certain items on their food menu and condiments. From whip cream to hollandaise sauce. I've even had plates with finger prints from the servers on my food...

Made reservations this past Saturday night at Cobalt Smoke & Sea. When we arrived we were politely greeted and promptly seated. This restaurant is modern and nicely decorated. It has these cool & dimly lit (Ginko I think) tree's inside the dining room that provide a good ambiance. 
We were greeted within a few minutes by our happy waitress who took our drink order. A minute or two later she brought out our water and said our drinks would be out shortly and they were a minute or two later. As my wife and I were perusing the menu the Chef, Brian, was making his rounds thru the dining room. He filled us in on the specials and answered all of our questions. I ordered two appetizers one being the bourbon shrimp and the other the beet chips. They were both phenomenal with so much flavor.
For dinner we both wanted to try the Burnt Ends with soba noodles. The Burnt Ends were perfection and the sauce added a good flavor that accompanied the smoked meat. The noodles were also good and added a different upscale experience to the dish. All throughout the meal our waitress was attentive and the wait time was appropriate for the crowd.  
We also ordered two deserts, the seared Banana cake and the Ding Dong!  Again, both dishes were phenomenal!  
I also want to add that there was live music playing and at a nice SOFT LEVEL ! so you could hold a conversation, Well Done Cobalt ! 
I will definitely be back and bring friends to experience this fresh place.
Bowls are extendable and delectable! However workers are a bit rude and bland but wow the bowls are amazing my friends from back home come to visit for the bowls.

bistro 7 is our family fave place for a din out besides steak/shake...which is excellent...but we meet here on occasion for papa pays nite.  papa most enjoys the wine & pizza.  i always ask for new clairvoux wine, but alas none to be had.  not to worry, lots to pick fm.  i really like this bar as it is smallish, excellent offering and best of all not noisy.  i mean, you can actually sit at the bar and glancing up at tv with no  sound and still hear whoever you are visiting with.  bar tender always has an alternative to my fave new clairvoux and have never been disappointed.  

grandmunchkin orders the steak frities or truffles...proclaims it best steak ever, well duh you're 13.  suffice we had a grand sampling of the menu.  oh they take advantage of this ol geezer at each dinner opportunity.  truly excellent pizza, i think it was the margherta or something like that.  see, we all share everything.  so bucko, want a piece of pizza...slide some of  that steak over here.  yep, he nailed it.  best steak ever.  i did  notice wife & munchkins rightful owners scarfed their selection, each sez excellent dinner & service.  wife & I travel up to reno fm redding as munchkin lives in carson city often enuf to  have fave places.  that marriott courtyard is a block away makes bistro a place to enjoy and still be only a block away fm hotel. (and indoor heated pool!)

we will be back come Nov for our papa bd din...course i will maneuver the munchkin into saying hey papa, you like the bistro
Karen was GREAT...nice clean place with good eats!  I had lunch ribs.  The sauce is my fav.

Although I despise your company for it's anti-LGBTQ support, I will occasionally go for a sandwich if I'm starving. I was thoroughly impressed with the drive through service during the pandemic when I visited today. You have a wonderful staff at this location based on what I saw today. I needed to compliment the staff despite my opinion of this corporation.

Since I was in the area I decided to go to one of my favorite Poke bowl spots. This location is fairly new. I ordered 2 large poke bowls my way to go. By the time my server finished my bowls looked like a regular size servings. I guess I'm spoiled at the other location in the international mall. The only reason. I think the bowls should be different sizes to compare instead of using the same size bowl for both sizes. I gave 3 stars because the place was very clean. Overall I don't think I'll return to this location due to their shirt servings for a large poke bowl. Back to my side of town where they know how to make my poke bowl MY WAY!

This restaurant is OUTSTANDING!!! From the food and drinks to the service hands down it's a must eat when in Nashville!!! I've been to Nashville for the holidays the last five years and this was the first time we visited. The menu looked amazing so I told my family we have to go. We went on Saturday morning after Black Friday. We started with drinks I had the Marine Biologist and my cousins had the Good Samaritan and something else but they all were amazing! The we ordered all the appetizers (avocado toast, shrimp toast, califlower and Brussel sprouts, and crab fingers)except the gumbo (it has pork sausage). Then we had the marsh omelette with crab and one with veggies and crab, the fried chicken, Johnny cakes with salmon, cornbread, blueberry muffin. OH MY GOODNESS!!! Everything was so flavorful!!! We're going back this is anew tradition!!! Shout out to John, Nick and Bridgette!!! Also the nice young lady hostess with cute blond short cut your service with a smile and John's bartender skills all great assets to this establishment!!!

Updating my review from three years ago, Vintage continues among my favorite wine bars, although the competition in this neighborhood has increased significantly. On my most recent visit, our server, Miranda, was highly attentive, a remarkable feat given how busy this place can become. On a previous visit, the wait person was immensely helpful in choosing wines - he seemed to truly know the list very well and was quite articulate about each wine on the list. The menu is not huge by any means, but complements the wine listing really well. It includes some great choices. The Steak Frites got five stars, but be prepared for the large fries quantity. They are indeed excellent. The bruschetta with pickled apples, figs, and gorgonzola was also a great choice. I've had the seasonal veggie burger (currently root vegetables, jackfruit, fennel, cheese, mushrooms, and orange pickled fennel) here many times, and while not the greatest I've ever had (I find the texture a bit too soft and mushy), it's a good, reliable item. Seating in the front windows is a real plus, too, if it's available. Note the wine bottle chandelier and cork wall screen in the back.
Salty food . Horrible customer service . This has been for years now all for the food to not even be that good  please take your money to vernies instead

Had to try this place out, as it's been saying opening soon for months. We came with a group of 7. Around 930pm on a Sunday and it was quite empty. 

A couple people ordered burgers and said they were good and would come back. I ordered the trio with chicken which in my opinion maybe the same oz in meat but when you go into the custom additions to the burger it multiplies by 3. So my trio and jalapeño cheese fries came out to $30.00 and that's why I gave a 4 also because I ordered sautéed onions but got raw. 

Next time I plan on not doing the trio as well as try the wings.

Till next time..

Let me preface by saying: WE ARE IN GLOBAL PANDEMIC AND I WILL COME BACK AGAIN!

While I am extremely thankful that Sabrina's Cafe was open and available to feed me in a time of need. I gotta keep it real. While the dine in experience may be significantly better the take out experience was not that impressive. 

Let's start with the ordering process,  very smooth and simple. I'd recommend you have your form of payment handy and available. Once ordered the food was done in 15mins.  

Now here is my issue. The transportation of the food from the restaurant to home was problematic. I'm assuming due to the packaging and the temperature of the food. By the time I got home, the waffles and chicken became soggy. 

I know this isn't 100% their fault but when you are charging $15.00 for breakfast, I need the packaging to be right for take out and not lose out on the experience. Again, I will be back when things return to "normal" to provide an update. Hopefully this is can help others as well. In the meantime, thank you to the staff at Sabrina's Cafe for providing great customer service.

Great food. We came here for brunch and all of the food we ordered was delicious. You can tell that the food was made with love! I with they had halal food, so they could serve their community better, but maybe in the future!

I thought I'd check out this place, Sunday March 11, 2019. Had the special, shredded zucchini and summer squash shrimp scampi.  Six small shrimp with about a half of cup of veggies in a garlic butter sauce. It would have made a nice appetizer but as an  Entree way overpriced at $16 and left still hungry. No doggy bag needed.

Amazing food and service 
Would highly recommend. The food came out fast and was amazing don't hesitate to try it

Great food. Very flavorful but not too hot. Portions were large. Fajitas were delicious. Steak was tender. Combo platter of a taco and enchilada was decent enough. The taco was pretty small but tasty. Chicken enchilada was very good.  Service was friendly and attentive. Refills were slow but we did get them. The margaritas were delicious.

I really enjoy Big Jay's they cook to perfection and you get plenty for your money. I also like the variety Big Jay's have to offer. Been a favorite since the winter of 2017. Try it you won't be disappointed.
Amazing!!! Nothing like a cheesesteak from Tony Luke's wit Wiz. This is hands down the best cheesesteak spot in south philly.

We found this place listed with good reviews as an upscale restaurant, but left feeling like we'd visited a tourist trap. Is it normal for restaurants in New Orleans that offer pricey appetizer, salad and entree courses to bring all three out to your table at once? That's how ours came out. It was weird. The food gets cold - how do they not know how that works? Also, when the restaurant is pretty empty and you still get rushed, inattentive service, and then the server drops off the check without ever asking if there's anything else, (drink refills, coffee, dessert) - it's more like eating at Denny's than a place charging fine dining prices. So, 2 stars only because the food was okay, (though we've had better for way cheaper in this same area). Maybe they had an off night, maybe our waitress was poorly trained - don't know, but it was too expensive for a poor dining experience and just okay food.

THIS PLACE IS SLEPT ON!!!! This just became my favorite breakfast in Indy!! It's cheap, clean, hot coffee, breakfast served all day, amazing customer service, social distancing is practiced, and workers wear mask! There was indoor and outdoor seating, this place is huge you guys and it's bright on the inside!! When I tell you my coffee was hot every time I am not lying!! You could see the heat coming off that cup! I highly recommend this place for brunch! The mimosa was so good!! Fruit was fresh and a good variety! I asked for crispy bacon and that's exactly what I got! 10/10 y'all!

Only pho place I go to everytime I visit Reno! This is probably the only authentic pho restaurant in the area that I'm aware of. I've tried other pho places in town and they were so bland. Customer service may not be the best here but the food is great! Pho is best for hangovers!
Spent over 50 dollars for 2 pizzas that were crap! All I tasted was the oils and garlic. For the price I paid you would think they would give you a good pizza. Never eating there again.
Really awesome happy hour!! Only complaint was the green bean salad was not very good - burger and schnitzel was amazing!

This place is gorgeous it's awesome , I was in town for the Essence festival and meet up with a friend whose a native new orleanean and she suggested this place.. Even though there was some businesses in New Orleans that "pretended" to be closed.. This place was above reproach & I can feel the "TRUE"  Southern HOSPITALITY. We were seated promptly & the wait staff were truly gracious and very friendly. Mimosas were delish!!!  Fresh orange juice you just can't lose here.. Tou will definitely miss out on some delicious breakfast in New Orleans if you skip this place here

Ok, so I wanted to try them twice before posting this review, just to be sure I wasn't losing my mind with how insanely good my food was. From the moment I sat down my pleasant experience began. Our server was very polite and attentive. He was able to suggest some great apps and meat selections. 

We tried the truffle fries and root veggies. Each were cooked to perfection and quite tasty.

For entrees, we ordered two meat boards with multiple cuts of aged beef selections. OMG I've never tasted a better selection of beef. And to top it off, it came to the table flaming

The husband and I had dinner at Marokko this past weekend and we had an amazing experience. Started off with hummus plate, and they added a complementary cabbage lemon confit. The hummus is so rich & creamy and the pita is to die for! We also got the slow braised chicken Marrakech tajine which is filled with so much flavors and finger licking good. Also got the lamb shank tajine - the meat is itself is so soft and literally falls off the bone but the sauce could have been more flavorful but overall, great dish. High recommend!! And the owner is fantastic and very friendly!

My review isn't about the rooms or stay this is specifically about the bar. Any time I'm in town I stop in to have a drink (or three) and it is always delicious. Last time I was there I was excited to try Santa Barbara's winning cocktail of the year and it was amazing with local honey and other delicious ingredients. I also purchased the copper Moscow mule mug that came in a beautiful wood box and satin case: free first drink with purchase of the $50 mug and $10 there after. Anyway, on my latest trip (about 6 months later) I brought the mug and met the lovely bartender Martin. Not only did he make a great Moscow mule he also made me THE BEST drink I've ever had! I'm not sure what it was but I believe it was tequila, something else (it's a mystery) and lots of fruit, cucumber and jalapeños. On top of this, the other bartender Kimberly made the best pina colada I've ever tasted! Martin also remembered it was my birthday from my prior visit and brought me out a beautifully displayed pastry.
Martin, if you happen to read this THANK YOU SO MUCH for making my day even more special and I can't wait to have another one of those tequila drinks !

Both the manager and the cashier should be fired. I guess I was too slow in line when checking out because the cashier felt it necessary to shout 'OH SHE DOESNT HAVE ANY MONEY'. Is that how you treat people who want to spend money here? Honestly Wawa, f**k you.

Wondering why The Barn is closed from time to time? Well it keeps getting shut down by the health department, and for some reason being allowed to reopen its doors. From their most recent health inspection (and the last one was equally as atrocious) June 2019:

"Mouse feces was found on the table in food prep area and in the corners of prep and warewashing areas; a large amount of drain flies were found throughout bar area, especially around beer dispensing hose; paper towel, trash can and soap were not available at hand wash sink in food prep area; a Person in Charge was not present at all times; cooked potentially hazardous ready-to-eat food including soups and sauces that were prepared in the food facility and held for more than 48 hours, located in the refrigerator, were not date marked with the date they were prepared; potentially hazardous opened commercially processed ready-to-eat food including shredded cheese, located in the refrigerator, and held more than 48 hours, was not marked with the date it was opened; there was a leak on hand washing sink in prep and and on wash and sanitizing compartments of warewashing sinks; there was an unapproved domestic refrigerators and reach-in freezer; the prep sink was not sealed to wall; the refrigerator gasket cover was missing; the cold holding unit was not in use/operational; there was inadequate lighting throughout facility."

Food was good 
Service was terrible 
Waited more 30 minutes for eggs and flatbread 
Food 4 stars 
Service 1 star

Recently opened after stay at home orders and they are following all of safe protocols. I ordered the Loco Moco, white rice with eggs over easy. OMG! Cannot get this, in my humble opinion, anywhere better than Hawaii. Thank you LiLi, cooks & staff!

Due to COVID-19, you can only order via online. They are allowing "dine in" currently but only two tables outside. None of the tables inside were available when I went. They are also not currently offering any of their lemonades or specialty drinks which is one of the main reasons I go. Also no refills currently if you "dine in" which I really don't get. I'm all for whatever each individual restaurant/chain feels they need to do to keep safe during this pandemic though so I'm not complaining. I probably wouldn't come back to this place until things are normal though. Some places are just better when there are NO restrictions and Blaze is one of them. The pizza itself was fine. I've had better though to be honest, given the price tag. My girlfriend claims they have one of the best gluten free options so I'd take that into effect for any one with dietary restrictions.
Just okay, not that great. Satisfied with the food, but it was pretty expensive. But a good option if you're looking for Thai food.
Best margaritas, best mojitos, best salsa bar, best food. Best tacos, patio and amigos! A must try!!

Chose this place for my 40th bday dinner and it was a disaster.

My friend did everything she could to plan ahead for my special bday evening, but unfortunately everything she was promised did not happen.

She had reserved a room for our large party (even put a deposit down) only to be told the day before that due to "laws" this room could no longer be used but that we would instead have a private room.  yet that original room WAS in fact being used- just not by us. Guessing it was because they first accused us of being late (which we were not) so they must have double booked it despite charging my friend the initial deposit. 

We were flexible, but then from the moment we arrived things just continued to go downhill.

We were placed in a room (similar to a conference room with no windows to the restaurant like our desired room had) with TVs playing movies and football in the background despite our repeated asks to have those turned off as they greatly affected the ambiance. In addition, we had to be split into two tables (which we were flexible with though disappointed). The Service was slow, the employees were rude, it took me over 30 mins to even get my drink (as the birthday girl). When the food Did come out- it was cold. Cold as in butter on top of my steak didn't even melt. Very disappointing especially considering the price point for what were paying. Couldn't even look forward to a birthday cake because we didn't want to pay the ridiculous fee to bring in an outside c

So, the first time i took the fam here it was Deeeeelicious.   Got some to go today...it was just like Dominoes, maybe worse.   Scantily toppings and kinda bland. Got in trouble with the wife for suggesting this again. Not sure I will come back. Same experience with blind onion..  ( sad face). Tw this was mushroom garlic linguica  with extra sauce.  :(

First visit to Lotus Inn since U Know What started.  So glad we decided to get out of the house and dine in.  Dinner was delicious!  Even better than before!  Huge thank you to our waitress, Jenny.  So pleasant, funny and upbeat.  10 stars to you!  The Kung Pao chicken had a great spicy sauce, not burn your tongue off but a perfect blend of taste and heat.  My husband had sushi and sashimi platter which was perfectly sized and delicious, plus a special roll.  Everyone was masked and keeping social distance.  We felt safe and welcomed.   Support Local!

Came to "streetery" and this place had spanish music playing from the outside so we came in.

FUN!!! Adult , old school arcade type of bar!!! 

Huge jumbo slices of pizza are avail for less then $3. Beer, wine, licquor, soda all avail. The TV screens were broadcasting old WWE fights. Music was good. Place closed at 10PM. 

Small tables to sit and along the windows, they were all open so you could feel outside.

Will def come back!

I cannot brag enough about the customer service and courtesy of the entire staff at this location!! You can hear their smile through the intercom and everything is served fast and fresh!! Five stars to the entire staff and whoever is training at this location needs national recognition!! This is my seventh or eighth visit and every single time has been an enjoyable experience!

Food was decent when it finally came out. Service was absolutely terrible! The place had MAYBE 10 people in it, the hostess sat us and the waitress came over about 20 min later to take a drink order. Was able to read the menu cover to cover 5 times.. drinks ran dry over and over, waitress would show up every 30 min then disappear. Table was in the corner with no lighting, cell phone glow was the brightest source of light. Asked about the lighting, 30 min later asked again, no idea...very slow service for a slow week night at a non-busy crappy sports bar....

Make sure you check your food if you're getting to go or for pick up before you leave. So many times do they forget things in your food and when my hungry dumb ass forgets to check, of course they've left out things. 
For example, today, I ordered a vermicelli rice bowl with shrimp and beef and I asked for onions. They have forgotten the shrimp and the onions.
Additionally, they purposefully keep the lines busy so no one can call. So I can't even call them before the pickup and after the pickup to complain.

We went here as a group of three on a Friday night. We had a reservation, and didn't wait long at all to be seated-less than 10 minutes. The restaurant is pretty inside and out and the menu is full of interesting and unique options. I had the arrancini as an appetizer-so good! They just melted in my mouth. I chose pepperoni pizza for my entree and it was excellent-cooked exactly as I requested, with light sauce. The service was quick, friendly and attentive and the inventive cocktails were super flavorful. I'll definitely be back.
Tried the bacon shake. Was really good especially since when I finished the shake there was a bunch of bacon at the bottom. SCORE!!

Rude and unprofessional.  Drove there for nothing. The woman took our order, didn't take a name and just said ok and hung up.  We arrived and she said it would be ready in 10 minutes.  We walk back in the store and she said she had no idea of the order.  Horrible.
Frenchys is never a disappointment! It's always a fun, laid back kind of place to be at! Always great drinks and food here! grouper cheeks only at the original Frenchys are my favorite!

I have been wanting to try Truland for a while now and finally got the opportunity to try it when I was on that side of town. It was very reminiscent of Zinburger. Upper scale burgers and a la cart fries. The fries were awesome! The garlic fries out of this world. The portions are huge though, so 2-3 people can easily share an order. The truffle fries were good but I'd definitely pick the garlic fries. The burger was pretty good. I think next time I would get something more simple. The jalapeños on the burger were definitely HOT. I also missed the lettuce, tomato, and onion. There are 2 patties on the burgers which I didn't realize so they are definitely a lot. Anyways, I'll definitely be back next time I get the chance.

A bit hard to spot if you are passing by but rewarding if you stop in. Great service in a comfortable environment. Had brunch there, the eggs bennidict were excellent and the sticky toffee pudding was amazing. Lot's of other items on the menu I want to go back and try on my next visit.

Went with a friend to plays a couple games. The bartender/prob the owner, came over twice to tell me to stop leaning/sitting on the tables and slammed a chair down right next to me. His demeanor was so ridiculous I thought he was joking. I was barely leaning or touching the adjacent table more than a few seconds while my friend took a shot. 
I ordered a couple drinks and then left my card to keep a tab open. Minutes later he came to the table and demanded my ID to be held with the credit card.I've never been asked that before, it seems strange, when I questioned Him, be became defensive and said "the ID needs to match credit card. NEVER in all my years of giving my card to the bar to keep a tab open have I been asked to also give my ID.
It seems very sketchy for him to require an ID along the credit card on file. I'm seriously considering replacing the credit card I gave him because I do not trust the entire situation.
Wonderful local Chinese restaurant. Perfectly executed chinese entrees. Egg rolls on point.
Best thom ka in Tucson! I loved coming here for their buffet but it's on Hiatus during Covid :(. I want to try their pad Thai but I always default to their thom ka because it's that tasty!

NOT CURRENTLY OPEN WITH COVID. Very sad about their closure. No outside seating, so it makes it hard for this restaurant to be open. Only positive things to say: easy lunch spot, friendly staff. Good quality pho. When it re-opens and if you're downtown, give this place a try. It won't disappoint.

Love, love, love the chicken and grilled shrimp Tacos!
The margaritas are excellent and the atmosphere is extremely welcoming.  I was hesitant to try the chocolate churros initially but they were delish.

So I've been hesitant to try Mangia for no particular but after friend and neighbor of mine mentioned how good it was I had to give it a try. I Just purchased the "choose your own" option and order the linguine, pesto and shrimp option. It was AMAZING! It also comes with bread and a side salad. The bread comes with an herb butter and the salad is made with quality ingredients. So glad I gave it a try.
Great location, pizza was outstanding , great variety of beers and wine, nice apps can be used for small plate dinner,very hip place mid town Carmel is hot

This is a good spot for Carnitas.  Plenty of food for a filling meal at a reasonable price.  Included beans and rice and guacamole salad.  The corn tortillas were hot and steamy and held up well for dining on the carnitas.  One of the best carnitas meal I have enjoyed in Indianapolis

First time trying  Sweetwaters, their staff was disconnected and a little bit rude. Their coffee tasted like coffee you would get from a hotel. both my coffee and my boyfriends. The bagels were actually delicious. But being that my boyfriend and myself were the only customers in the store, they got my boyfriends order wrong and gave him a bagel instead of the biscuit he asked for.
Solid thai food, good portions and good prices. Overall good experience, would definitely return

We are from Michigan and wanted a hometown place to eat. Clear Sky on Cleveland delivered. From the hostess to the owner, everyone one was very accommodating and hospitable. The porter house was cooked perfectly, the ramen was savory, and the drinks were amazing. To emphasize, the service was the spectacular. We all felt at home.

This place is so cute and delicious. I loved their sweet mage latte (sage, Himalayan pink salt, and dark caramel) it was so goooood. They have homemade gf bread and their breakfast sandwiches are delicious.

Great location right on Kennedy just East of Westshore Blvd, lots of parking behind building.  Clean dining area and rest rooms.  Fresh organic and Vegetarian options.  Sad that Salsa and guacamole is an up charger.  Place was hopping busy.  Try the impulse buy at the checkout register "cookies" they are amazing, vegan and come in a 4 pack.
Amazing food! Never usually have to wait long for the food to come out. Just wish the food came out a bit warmer.

It's hard finding authentic ethnic food in Nashville without traveling miles away from down town. This is one of them. Do yourself a favor and add this to your rolodex if you enjoy Korean food. Or if you enjoy trying new cuisine this is where it's done right if you want the recipes done correctly.

I chose this spot for a pre-movie dinner with  y boyfriend, and it was hands-down THE best, most satisfying meal I've had at a restaurant in a while! 
I started off with a beer flight and the lobster flatbread. Let me tell you this flatbread was EVERYTHING I hoped for and more. Crust was perfectly light and crisp, the lobster chunks were huge and perfectly cooked. 
And then I had the Drunk Monk Burger (with bacon instead of mushrooms) and again, phenomenal! Flavorful aioli, everything cooked perfectly, and the brie was such a good addition.

I could not rave enough about it!
Just the most wonderful experience! Theresa was great from start to finish with every detail even though she was absolutely slammed. Can't wait to go back!

In general, I prefer traditional authentic Japanese food.  I will always compare all of my sushi meals to Karbuto in Las Vegas.  I decided to give Morimoto a try knowing that it is a fusion/modern take on Japanese food.  I had the Omakase at $125 for an 8 course meal.  After taxes and tips, it was a $170 meal.  Some of the courses were delicious (poached lobster, nigiri, and the black cod roasted in miso) and some were OK (Australian Weygu, tuna tartar with caviar, and Japanese cheese cake).  Overall, I enjoyed the meal and the ambience, but will not likely come back unless it is for a very special event and my companion insists on going.

MOD Pizza is a pretty good, build-your-own pizza chain. This particular location has some pretty chipper employees and I have yet to see them make a mistake on an order. MOD is nice because you're able to basically take any pizza (they do have a menu that has some "pre-built" pizza topping combos) and just turn it into a salad. The garlic bread is made from their same, standard pizza crust and has a good flavor, but avoid the edges unless you are someone who is into super crispy textures. I also recommend trying the "No Name  Cake," which is a glorified Ding Dong, but it has a much richer flavor. Overall, I definitely recommend checking this place out since the ingredients and cook style is far superior to other pizza chains.
Coffee was delivered fast and it was hot and delicious. The workers weren't just there to work, but actually made conversation. Fun environment!

I've ordered from here about 5 times for delivery & every single time my order has been messed up. When you call the store the manager refuses to help with issues. I understand I paid with Uber eats, but Uber didn't mess up my order 5 times YOUR RESTAURANT DID. It's like the restaurant knows they can't do anything about Uber orders so they just don't care. 5 times isn't a coincidence. Never ordering from your establishment again.

I was hesitated to go here because I'm asian and this place looks not authentic and waiting for disappointment. I see white and black dudes are cooking in kitchen. Lol so sorry. 
But finally I gave a try. 
It was surprisingly good! It's pricey but it's all good. My kids loved all dishes too. 
Korean double fried chicken wings are amazing!
We will be back to try some more.

This was a great Nashville find. The moonshine drinks were fantastic. A little pricey though. And then the pizza is fantastic. We have also had the hot chicken and mac n cheese, which is delicious. All of the other times we have been, the food has also been great. And the staff is ALWAYS friendly. 

Plus the live music on the roof top is fun!

Service was absolutely horrible... longest wait in history for food, even in a crowded restaurant! Our server dropped off some salads and was gone for 15-20 minutes! My plate was filthy and my wife's Brussel Sprouts were burnt!!

In the past I have always had a great experience with Methodist Hospital. However ever since they merged with IU the quality of care has gone way downhill. On my last visit they lost at least 100 dollars worth of my personal possessions and never even attempted to look for them or compensation me for the loss of them. Lacey who is a case manager there informed me that I would not be able to find home healthcare when she didn't even try to find it. Thus forcing me to go to a very subpar rehab where I was neglected and injured even more. Needless to say I'll never be back to Methodist.

I ordered half Peking duck, duck wonton soup, dumplings, and shrimp lo mein. The duck was cooked perfectly, however I realistically could have comfortably eaten an entire duck myself. The half duck portion is very small and weighs approximately 6 ounces (including all the skin and fat). The duck wonton soup was very good, however the broth was incredibly salty. I picked the wontons and pork from the soup and did not drink any of the broth. The dumplings were cooked perfectly and very flavorful. We were unable to use the sauce for the dumplings because it was so salty we thought it was made incorrectly. It wasn't edible. The shrimp lo mein was very good, standard from what you would expect at a Chinese restaurant.
